name: anypdf
description: Secure agent-native PDF form filling, one-shot intake, and Tell-Jacky feedback.

interface.shortDescription: Fill official PDF forms through the AnyPDF CLI.
interface.longDescription: Use the bundled AnyPDF CLI (anypdf router skill) to fill registered PDF forms, ask for a missing form two ways (Tell Jacky text, or a direct form request with an official blank PDF), and send Jacky a note. Answer from the live CLI, never a remembered form list. macOS Apple Silicon and Windows x64.
defaultPrompt: Submit this official blank PDF as a new form request.
Tell Jacky to support this missing form.
Tell Jacky about an AnyPDF bug or feature idea.
